data.name: Eruin
data.detailed_description:
Eruin is a single-player fantasy RPG where every conversation is real, no dialogue wheels, no scripts, no cloud. You talk, the characters listen, think, and respond. And what you say changes the game.

A spell has taken every memory in a walled town. Yours included. You wake under a night that never ends with no name, no past, and nothing left but your voice among strangers who seem to know your face. Ask the right questions, and the past starts answering back.

Talk to characters naturally with your microphone or type, if you prefer. No dialogue trees. Ask anything, argue, joke, lie. Key characters understand what you actually say and answer in their own voice.

*Microphone optional, full text input supported.*

Dialogue never locks you into a menu and never pauses the world. Move around, interrupt, hesitate, or walk away mid-sentence and characters can react to that.

Conversations aren't decoration, they're gameplay. Convince the gatekeeper you're worthy and the city gate actually opens. Fail the witch's riddle and she may just turn you into a frog, which isn't a game over, but the start of another playable sequence. A conversation gone wrong changes the adventure instead of ending it.

Every key character has their own personality, knowledge, and unique voice. They know the lore of their world, and they remember what you told them ten minutes ago, promises, contradictions, how you treated them. Confide, interrogate, befriend, or deceive: your words follow you.

The town has lost its memories, and you're the only one asking questions. Notice what doesn't add up, recover fragments of the past, and understand the spell and your own connection to the kingdom.

Speech recognition, AI dialogue, voice synthesis, lip sync, everything runs locally on your graphics card. No cloud. No subscription. No account. No data ever leaves your machine. If the internet disappeared tomorrow, Eruin would still work.

Eruin is built by hand, not generated. Purple forests, a riddling witch, a gatekeeper with standards — the world, characters, mystery, and trials are authored by a human, brought to life by characters who can actually talk about them.

data.short_description: You wake without a name in a town stripped of its memories. No one remembers who they are, including you. Speak with its inhabitants, piece together what was forgotten, and unravel the spell before the kingdom disappears with its past.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 Super 6GB / AMD RX 5600 XT 6GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible.
  • Additional Notes: 6GB VRAM minimum. Vulkan-compatible GPU required for AI inference.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i7-12700 / AMD Ryzen 7 5800X
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 12GB / AMD RX 6700 XT 12GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible. Microphone required.
  • Additional Notes: 12GB VRAM recommended for faster AI response times.
